items.name: update
items.author: assistant-ui
items.description: Safely migrate an existing AI-powered application from Vercel AI SDK v4 or v5 to v6 without breaking core functionality.
items.summary: The update skill upgrades existing assistant-ui projects to current releases and runs the resulting migrations. Use it when bumping @assistant-ui/react, @assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk, ai, or @ai-sdk/react, resolving peer-dependency conflicts, or fixing post-upgrade type errors from renamed APIs. Phase one detects installed versus latest versions via npm ls and npm view, then routes through breaking-change references for each jump. AI SDK below 6.0.0 triggers the v4 or v5 to v6 migration guide covering toDataStreamResponse to toUIMessageStreamResponse and maxSteps to stopWhen stepCountIs. assistant-ui below 0.14.0 covers primitives components prop to children render functions, ViewportSlack removal, and useAssistantApi to useAui. Migration order is AI SDK first, then assistant-ui, then verification with npx tsc --noEmit and pnpm build. Execution runs npx assistant-ui@latest upgrade and pnpm or npm add @latest. Troubleshooting covers peer conflicts, type errors after upgrade, and runtime API mismatches. For first-time install or fresh scaffold, the setup skill is the correct entry point instead of update.

items.name: santa-method
items.author: affaan-m
items.description: Run two independent AI reviewers that must both approve before any user-facing output, code, or content is published or deployed.
items.summary: The santa-method skill implements multi-agent adversarial verification with a convergence loop. A generator produces the artifact, then two independent reviewers with no shared context evaluate the same rubric in parallel. Both must pass before output ships; otherwise a fix cycle collects all flags, repairs issues, and re-runs dual review until convergence or escalation. Use before public deploy, compliance-sensitive releases, customer-facing copy, or high hallucination-risk content where single-reviewer bias is unacceptable. Do not use for internal drafts or tasks already covered by build, test, and lint pipelines. Architecture phases are generate, dual independent review, verdict gate, and fix cycle with a configurable maximum iteration count. Reviewers return structured pass or fail per rubric criterion with cited issues rather than prose summaries. The method targets outputs where accuracy, brand constraints, or regulatory language require independent double-checking rather than spot review alone.
highlights: Covers santa-method quick start, workflow steps, and reference pointers from SKILL.md.
